runningCloseFirst: That recompilation is running; close it first.
notInCatalog: That recompilation is not in the catalog.

files.installFirst: Install the recompilation first; then pick its game files.
files.pickFile: Pick a file, not a folder.
files.pickFolder: Pick a folder, not a file.
files.extractFirst: {what} Pick the folder with the disc's files: extract a disc image first (with {tool}).
files.nested: {picked} holds {folder} (or the other way round); pick the folder with the game files only
files.folderInTheWay: A folder is in the way of {path}

saves.runningCopiedOnClose: It is running; its saves are copied when you close it.
saves.tooBroad: That folder is too broad to copy (pick the game’s own save folder).
saves.ownFolder: That folder is one of PlayOut’s own (pick the game’s own save folder).
saves.runningPick: It is running; close it before picking which saves to keep.
saves.dirGone: The recompilation's folder {dir} is gone, and PlayOut could not find where it moved.
saves.emulationUnreachable: The Emulation folder {folder} cannot be reached.
saves.unknownLocation: PlayOut does not know where this recompilation saves yet (play it once).
saves.backupTooLarge: The backup would be over 4 GB.
saves.tooLarge: The saves take {size} MB, more than the {max} MB PlayOut syncs; check the save folders.
saves.changedWhileCopying: The saves changed while they were being copied; try again.
saves.copyMismatch: The saves copied back from the Emulation folder do not match the copy there.
saves.unknownLocationShort: PlayOut does not know where this recompilation saves yet.
saves.stillArriving: The copy in the Emulation folder is still arriving (or incomplete); PlayOut will try again.
saves.stillArrivingMeta: The copy in the Emulation folder is still arriving (its meta.json is missing or can't be read yet); PlayOut will try again.
saves.noLocal: There are no saves on this PC to keep.
saves.freshChanged: The saves came back on this PC meanwhile, so nothing was changed. Choose again.
saves.noCloud: There are no saves in the Emulation folder to keep.
saves.stillArrivingRetry: The copy in the Emulation folder is still arriving (or incomplete); try again in a moment.
saves.tooManyFiles: The save folder {folder} holds more than {max} files, so it is not just saves.
saves.unreadable: PlayOut could not read {path} ({error}), so it leaves the saves as they are and tries again later (a OneDrive file may still be downloading).
saves.foldersDiffer: The copy's save folder(s) ({copy}) are not this PC's ({here}); set the same save folders on both PCs.

launch.alreadyStarting: {name} is already starting (PlayOut may be preparing the game for it); it opens when that is done.
launch.movingSetup: PlayOut is moving {folder} to the Recycle Bin; start {name} again when that is done.
launch.programNotFound: PlayOut could not find {name}'s program in {dir}. Choose it under Program on the Recompilation page.
launch.chosenGone: {file}, the program chosen for {name}, is no longer there. Choose another under Program on the Recompilation page.
launch.placeFilesFailed: Could not place the game files: {error}
launch.needsAdmin: {file} needs administrator rights; PlayOut does not start recompilations elevated.

setup.noHelper: PlayOut could not unpack your {game} disc for the setup (its Xbox image helper is missing).
setup.helperMissing: PlayOut's Xbox image helper is missing (reinstall PlayOut)
setup.couldNotUnpack: PlayOut could not unpack your {game} disc for the setup ({why}). The setup may refuse a trimmed disc image.
setup.folderHasFiles: {folder} already has files but no {marker}; move them away and try again
setup.wrongDisc: the disc image has no {marker}: it is not {game}
setup.unpacking: Preparing {game} for {name}: unpacking your disc image (this can take a few minutes)

imageStays.installsFromIt: {name} still installs from it (choose the game's program under Program first)
imageStays.needsFiles: {name} still needs its game files (pick them on the Recompilation page first)

busy.noLongerInstalled: the recompilation is no longer installed
busy.noLongerKnown: the recompilation is no longer known
busy.preparing: it is being prepared or started right now
busy.installing: the recompilation is installing or updating

folder.cannotDelete: folders cannot be deleted from here

offer.noFolder: Nothing was deleted: this question offers no game folder.
offer.noImage: Nothing was deleted: this question offers no disc image.
offer.noFiles: Nothing was deleted: files cannot be deleted here.
offer.alreadyMoving: {folder} is being moved to the Recycle Bin already.
offer.gameGone: {name} is no longer in your library.
offer.notUnpacked: PlayOut did not unpack it, or it is already deleted
offer.otherFolder: it is not the folder this question asked about
offer.movedBoth: Moved {name} and {folder} to the Recycle Bin
offer.movedFolderNotImage: Moved {folder} to the Recycle Bin, but not {name}: {error}

held.interrupted: PlayOut closed before the check finished
held.movedAside: Moved {what} aside. Starting {name} to check it runs without it; it goes to the Recycle Bin once you close the game and it ran fine.
held.stillChecking: PlayOut is still checking it; wait for the result.
held.cannotMove: Files cannot be moved from here.
held.startingAgain: Starting {name} again to check it runs without {what}

test.asksForFiles: {name} asks for its game files without it
test.saveConflict: its saves changed on this PC and in the Emulation folder; pick which to keep on its Recompilation page first
test.chooseExe: choose the program that starts {name} under Program on its Recompilation page first
test.passedMoved: {name} started without {what}; it is now in the Recycle Bin.
test.closedWithErrorSignal: {name} closed after {time} with an error (stopped by {signal})
test.closedWithErrorCode: {name} closed after {time} with an error (exit code {code})

image.notThisGame: That is not a recompilation of this game.
image.cannotDelete: Disc images cannot be deleted from here.
image.none: This game has no disc image on this PC.

version.installing: It is installing; wait until it finishes.
version.running: It is running; close it first.

cards.cannotAdd: Recompilations cannot be added to the library here.
cards.notInCatalogs: That recompilation is not in the catalogs.

listUnreadable: The recompilations list {file} cannot be read ({error}); try again in a moment.

install.unverified: This download has no published checksum, so PlayOut could not verify it.
install.unscannedAdd: Added by someone in PlayOut, not listed by a catalog: nobody virus-scanned this download, only GitHub’s checksum was checked.
install.notInstallable: {file} is not a file PlayOut can install (zip, 7z or a program)
install.noSpace: Not enough free space: {name} needs about {needed} free to install ({free} free)
install.checksumMismatch: {file}: the download does not match GitHub's checksum
install.backupFailed: Your files in {name}'s folder could not be backed up ({error}), so nothing was changed; try again
install.outsideFolder: {folder} is not inside PlayOut's Recompilations folder; delete it yourself if it is no longer wanted

programs.notInFolder: {file} is not in the recompilation's folder.

folderUse.programUnknown: the program that starts the game is not identified yet
folderUse.installedAround: the game is installed around it and reads its game data from it
folderUse.programAbove: its program sits in a folder that holds it, so the game may read it
folderUse.cwdAbove: the game is started in a folder that holds it
folderUse.recompAround: a recompilation is installed in or around it
folderUse.holdsGameFile: it holds a game file it reads

add.notGithub: That is not a GitHub link. Only GitHub repositories can be added.
add.badUrl: That could not be read as a repository. Paste its address, such as github.com/owner/repo.
add.notFound: No public repository was found there. It may be private, renamed or removed.
add.noReleases: That repository has no releases to download.
add.noWindows: None of that repository’s releases has a Windows download.
add.rateLimited: GitHub’s limit for checks was reached. Try again after {time}.
add.gameNotPlain: The game’s name cannot contain HTML or script links.
add.consoleUnknown: Pick a console from the list.
add.notAdded: That recompilation was not added on this PC.

import.chooseFolders: Choose the other launcher's folders (or app folders) to import
import.notScanned: That folder was not in the list PlayOut found; press Import and look again.
import.running: {program} is running from this folder: close it first.
import.recompBusy: That recompilation is installing or running in PlayOut: wait until it finishes.
import.gone: The folder is no longer there.
import.isLink: The folder is a link to another place, not the folder itself.
import.notWindows: Decomp Buddy set this one up for a console or another device, not for Windows.
import.noSpace: Not enough free space on the drive of the Recompilations folder: {needed} needed, {free} free.
import.inUse: Windows would not move the folder: a program still has one of its files open. Close the game and {launcher}, then try again.
import.stranded: The folder could not be put back and is now in {path}.
import.noteInstaller: Only the setup program is in this folder: after the import, choose the installed game's program on its Recompilation page.
import.noteGameInPlace: This recompilation reads your game files from where they are: PlayOut uses the game in your library, or asks for them on the first start.
import.noteVersionUnknown: Version unknown: PlayOut offers the newest release as an update on its page (not in Update all).
import.protected: {path} is a folder PlayOut or Windows needs where it is (the Emulation folder, PlayOut's own folders, your user folders or a whole drive): it is never moved.
import.processesUnknown: PlayOut could not check which programs are running, so it does not move this folder now. Try again.
import.noteDuplicate: Also installed with {launcher} in {folder}, which is chosen. Choose this one instead if you prefer it.
import.noteNameDiffers: {launcher} calls it {name}, but the catalog lists it under {game}: check that it is the right game.
